topic: ORAL Surveillance trial: cardiovascular safety of tofacitinib vs TNFi in RA

source.title: Risk of major adverse cardiovascular events with tofacitinib versus tumour necrosis factor inhibitors in patients with rheumatoid arthritis
source.whyItFits: Open analysis that reports the ORAL Surveillance primary cardiovascular comparison of tofacitinib versus TNF inhibitors, including the hazard ratio, non-inferiority margin, and age pattern.
